$comment: Which granted capabilities the assistant will actually USE, per account.
A scope cannot be narrowed. Once drive.file is in a token, nothing takes it
out except revoking the grant and consenting again -- so switching a
capability off here is a decision about what the assistant WILL use, not about
what it could. The two anyone would actually want off are drive and send,
which are exactly the two where that difference matters.
Tracked in git because it is a decision. The tokens are not.
reports as: granted mail,send -- in use mail. Never as 'send is absent'.
`triage: "hold"` keeps an account's mail OUT of the work list without
making it invisible. The extractor still reads the whole mailbox, the
counts still include it, and the differ says how many it is holding -- it
simply does not offer those threads for judgement.
This is not a way to make mail go away. Removing the key resumes triage on
the next tick, and nothing was archived or concluded while it was set.
